name: Fujimori Maya
source:
She has a model-like style, a beautiful face, and sex appeal that is hard to believe for a schoolgirl. She is famous among students as “an experienced bitch who plays a lot."

She loves money and spends it on clothes, accessories, and fun. She is quick-witted and hates trouble. When it comes to sex, she thinks that a man who is good at sex and satisfies her is the best.

She hangs out at school with her bitchy friends who are into nightlife and compensated dating. She is the complete opposite of the main character, who is a simple and unassuming boy.
